newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Jelmoli sees at least 50-60 mln Sfr 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Jelmoli sees at least 50-60 mln Sfr 1997 profit.

text.p: Swiss retailer Jelmoli Holding AG said it expected to reach or exceed its target of posting a 1997 group profit of 50 to 60 million francs.

"We expect that the projected earnings target of 50 million to 60 million in group profit for the whole year can be at least reached or surpassed because sales grew strongly in the second quarter (much better than in the first quarter) and in light of slightly improved consumer sentiment (households see their future financial situation the best since 1990)," it said.
It said first-half operating profit rose by around 20 million francs and financial profit rose around 10 million, but gave no absolute numbers. It will publish more details in September.
